newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish soldier killed in grenade accident.
newsitem.headline: Turkish soldier killed in grenade accident.

text.p: A Turkish soldier was killed on Tuesday when a grenade accidentally exploded in his hand in southeast Turkey, scene of fighting between Kurdish rebels and Turkish forces, security officials said.

The soldier, a non-commissioned officer, was together with two civilians in a car belonging to the mayor of the town of Balveren in Sirnak province where the accident took place, the official told Reuters.
The two civilians, relatives of the mayor, were wounded in the explosion, he said.

More than 21,000 people have died in 12-year-old armed struggle between security forces and Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
